book.name: Lum
book.title: Ŋwa wù Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ kintaashɛ ki Lum le

content: Le mɛ wù Bol wù mwa lɛme wu Kletu Jiso. Nyo gɛ̀ bee wu tɛɛŋ mɛ lɛ nyûme mwa ntuŋ wu Jiso, wu gɛɛ lɛ nfêeji saaka wù joŋe wù wu Nyo.
Saaka wù joŋe wunɛ le wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka wa bamii yu nchensɛŋ fede yi bamii be ba ntuŋ le, no fi le ba saŋ a Ŋwa we wù yuude le.
Wu le kune Mwa ye wù gɛ̀ tu muh wu wuŋ, ba boo wu a kfuu chi Nfoŋ Dabi le.
Tada wese besabɛŋ wù Jiso Kletu, le Nyo gɛ̀ dunyɛ wu fede yi Kiyo ki Yuude le, lɛ le Mwa ye wù kɛme bvuŋga no wu gɛ̀ bvusɛ wu yi kwe le.
Ge Jiso Kletu fɛ Nyo baa mɛ lɛ mɛ nnyûme mwa ye wu ntuŋ, wu lɛ ŋgê bamii ba woŋ bachii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ lêesɛ fitele yi ye ye le, bo yûge nyu wu le bo yuuse jee che.
Bɛŋ tɛ le ŋgoo yi bamii ba Nyo le wu tɛɛŋ lɛ bo nyu bamii ba Jiso Kletu.

Nsaŋe ŋwa wunɛ fɛ bɛŋ le bachii ba le fitele fì Nyo ba le Lum, ba wu le wu tɛɛŋ lɛ bo nyûme bamii ba le be. Nyo wù Chiji wese besabɛŋ bɛ Tada Jiso Kletu dûnyɛ fitele fì joŋe fɛ bɛŋ le, bo ka bo nyâ bɛŋ bɛ muntele mù nyiɛgee.
Bol gɛ̀ goone ki wu lâ jigɛ a bamii ba Lum le
Ŋgoone ki n'ya nya kiyone Nyo waŋ le nje bɛŋ bachii fede yi Jiso Kletu le, nje woŋ wuchii jɛme kune fitele fì bɛŋ le bɛŋ leesɛ yi ye ye le.
Nyo wù nlɛne wu le bɛ fitele fiaŋ fichii yi saaka wù joŋe wu kune Mwa ye, wu bɛɛyi jiŋ yi nsa waŋ, nto ŋkwaji bɛŋ segechii a buunɛ chaŋ le.
Ŋge ndoo mbuune nlɛge lɛ je nɛ taŋlo yi yɛnɛ, nto a bɛŋ le, mɛɛse, fɛ Nyo le wu bɛɛŋ,
nje ŋkoŋe baaŋ ki n'yɛ̂ŋ bɛŋ le, wu lɛ nyâ bɛŋ nnya yi a Kiyo le, yi gê bɛŋ tɛ̂ɛme.
Fì le lɛ, nɛ besabɛŋ yûfɛ muntele mwesa, fitele fì bɛŋ leese yi Nyo le yûfɛ fiaŋ, fiaŋ yûfɛ fiena.

Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, ŋgoone lɛ bɛŋ kɛɛ lɛ nle ŋka wa chikɛ le, chikɛ le, lɛ nlé nto, ŋka nɛ, fiɛɛ jeese gɛh mɛ. Ŋgoone lɛ nto ki ŋkɛ̂me ŋgwejɛ a bɛŋ le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no nle ŋkɛmɛ wa a bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu le gɛ.
Lɛme chinɛ fɛ bamii bachii le le yi kikwɛɛ kaŋ le, kɛnɛ le bamii ba woŋ wù yuu wa le, kɛnɛ le ba baaŋ nchvuuŋ, kɛnɛ le bamii ba kɛme bvufee, kɛnɛ le ba baaŋ biyuŋ.
Le fiɛɛ fì fitele fiaŋ bɛdɛ yu baaŋ ki nfêjɛ saaka wù joŋe bɛŋ ba Lum le tɛ.
Bvuŋga bvu saaka wù joŋe wu Nyo

Bɛŋ kêe lɛ gɛ ŋkɛme bvuya yi saaka wù joŋe wù wu Nyo le gɛ. Nje le fo fɛ bvuŋga bvu Nyo le, ki wu bvûsɛ muh wuchii wu le wu leesɛ fitele yi ye ye le, le. Saaka wunɛ gɛɛne ŋkuse nyu fɛ Bajuu le fɛ wu gɛɛŋ tɛ fɛ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu le gɛ.
Fì le lɛ saaka wù joŋe wunɛ duunyi je yì Nyo jode lɛ muh le chaaŋ a wu jii. Fi finɛ kɛge fi gɛɛŋ fi mɛsɛ yi fitele fì mwɛdɛ lese yi ye ye le. Nyu fiɛɛ fì ba le ba saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Muh wù chaaŋ lé wu chêe nje fitele fì wu lese yi Nyo le.”

content: Shɛ́ŋ bɛɛne Nyo bɛ bamii ba gee gɛ mwɛɛ mu chaaŋ gɛ
Njɛme nɛ fɛ ndu lɛ shɛ́ŋ yi Nyo to yi bɛɛne wu fɛwe bɛ bamii ba faŋe wu bò gee mwɛɛ mù le gɛ chaaŋ gɛ, gee chiboo chì befe chi yige kinchiɛɛŋ ki mwɛɛ kune Nyo.
Yi bɛɛne noo nje fiɛɛ fì bamii taŋlo ba kɛɛ kune Nyo le fi yɛne andaŋandaŋ, nje wu wù Nyo le wu chunyɛ wa bo le.

Kɛge lo fɛŋkɛɛ no Nyo gɛ̀ fɛ woŋ, bvuŋga bwe bvu kage gɛ, bɛ no wu wù Nyo le, fi nyu lɛ bamii le bo yɛŋ wa wu le bo ka bo kee wu yi mwɛɛ mù wu fɛ wa le, mo no bamii yɛde gɛ wu le gɛ. Noo, gɛ je ka nyume yu yi bo ge bo ja bo woose bo duu lɛ gɛ bo kee Nyo gɛ.
Mo no bo kee Nyo noo, gɛ bo ŋgvuune wu njɛ Nyo gɛ, kɛnɛ bo nyaa wu kiyone gɛ. Baŋkwajɛ baboo le bo ja bo tu ba achiji. Bikwɛɛ biboo bi biyɛse le bi yisɛ nyume bɛ kijibɛ.
Bo duu lɛ bo kɛmɛ bvufee, bo ja bo tu nyu biyuŋ.

Bo chinɛ ki bo bɛɛŋse Nyo wu bvukugɛ wù taŋlo wu gɛ kwe gɛ, bo tu bo buune nyume fɛ mumooso le mù ba kɛnyi bɛ chiaaŋ mu tu mu fiɛɛnɛ bamii ba taŋlo bo kweeyɛ, bɛ munyii mo nyáŋ yì jiɛnyi we, bɛ yì chiide ate kuu.
No fi le noo Nyo mo wu chinɛ bo le bo tu bo gee wa nyume mwɛɛ mù muntele muboo goone nyume mwɛɛ mu nyiɛŋ, bo gee noo bɛ ye yiboo, muh bɛ muh, bo mo choose bikwɛɛ biboo.

Bo le bo kusɛ nchiɛɛŋ kune Nyo wu tu chimbiaŋ, bo ka buune bo lɛne nyu mwɛɛ mù Nyo fɛ le, fede ki bo buune bo ka lɛne nyu wu wù le Nfɛ le. Nyume wu wù bo kɛme ki bo bɛ̂ɛŋse segechii bo luu gɛ. Fi nyûme noo.
No bo gee noo, Nyo mo wu chinɛ bo le, ye tu yi yufe bo ki bo gêe mwɛɛ mu kinchoosɛ. Bikɛse gime fɛ bikɛse bamu le, Nyo gɛ̀ baaŋ fɛ gɛ bikɛse lɛ bo gêe noo gɛ.

Le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no bilɛŋsɛ chinɛ je yì Nyo gɛ̀ fɛ lɛ bo gîme bɛ bikɛse yu, ye tu yi yufe bo ki bo gîme nyume fɛ bilɛŋsɛ bamu le. Bilɛŋsɛ gee mwɛɛ mu kinchoosɛ bɛ bilɛŋsɛ bamu. No bo gee noo bo mo jode ŋgɛ yi bikwɛɛ biboo le, wù le nlaŋɛ wù gee chiboo chi befe.
No bamii bayu baaŋ yɛŋ gɛ lɛ fi kooji ki bo kee Nyo gɛ, Nyo mo wu chinɛ bo le lɛ bo kɛ̂me bvufee nyu bvu kiyuŋ, bo mo bo gêe mwɛɛ mù bo kɛmɛ gɛ ki bo gêe gɛ.

Muntele muboo mo nyume mu yisɛ bɛ mwɛɛ mù mbefe yeye yeye. Bo gee gɛ mwɛɛ mu chaaŋ gɛ, bo ndefe ajii, bo kɛme muntele mù mbefe, bo bɛɛne bindoŋ bɛ bamii, bo yuuyi bamii, bo juu bvuju, bo lɛɛde kinlɛlɛ, bo jiiŋe bamii bɛ ajii a befe, bo kuuŋse kiŋkuŋsɛ,
bo chɛŋe bɛ ajee a bamii, bo banɛ Nyo, bo sɛɛnɛ bvusɛɛnɛ, bo tɛɛme bikwɛɛ, bo chiaase ye, bo mone bvulu, bo tɛɛme bikwɛɛ bɛ bachiji baboo mo babwee baboo.
Bo le biyuŋ bo ya lɛme gɛ yi jɛ yiboo le gɛ. Bo nyiɛge bɛ bamii bamu, bo koode gɛ yii fɛ bamii le gɛ.
Bo gee noo bo kee gɛh lɛ Nyo le wu lejɛ wa lɛ muh wù gee mwɛɛ munɛ kɛmɛ ki wu kwê. Geenɛ, bo gee gɛh bo gɛɛne yu fwe fwe, bo ka toone bamii bò gee kfuu chi munɛ mwɛɛ.

footnotes.text: Kɛnɛ lɛ, “Jiso Kletu le Nyo gɛ̀ dunyɛ bɛ bvuŋga bwe fede yi Kiyo ki Yuude le lɛ le Mwa ye no wu gɛ̀ bvusɛ wu yi kwe le.”
